payload.title: GPT 路线验证：Test A/B/C 与 R1-R3 prior-art

payload.task: 验证 GPT 报告中的路线，只做验证与反馈，不构思新路线

A_gauge_pathology.verdict: gauge dependence confirmed, BUT it is the known LQR covariant-invariance fact; fixing Q is a gauge choice; R2 novelty weak

B_ref_reachability_defect.verdict: first-order unreachable component is ~16-21% of lifted reference increment; R1 premise supported; multi-step not tested

C_residual_predictability.verdict: residual has predictable dynamics (17-25%); R3 premise supported

prior_art_R1_R2_R3.R1: delta exists but narrow; key delta = use reachability defect as representation-learning loss + multi-step reachable-subspace alignment; precedents: Korda-Mezic Automatica 2018 (arXiv:1611.03537), KTMPC arXiv:2208.12000, ScaRe-Kro arXiv:2601.01076, arXiv:2607.06459
prior_art_R1_R2_R3.R2: HIGH risk: LQR similarity invariance under covariant cost is a 1984 result (Majumdar 1984; Al-Iedani & Gajic 2020); fixing Q = choosing a gauge; physical-output cost (C^T Q C) is the standard fix (KF-LQR arXiv:2201.11640); KEEC arXiv:2312.01544 already enforces 'equivalent predictor -> equivalent control'
prior_art_R1_R2_R3.R3: method overlaps DEKC arXiv:2506.08319 and discrepancy modeling arXiv:2203.05164; needs a control-oriented theorem (identifiability / closed-loop bound / vs DOB-ESO condition)
